rationale: dual_domain_bilateral_n2i-claude-agentic: warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=0.005, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=2.5, img_sy=2.5, outer_wall_s=1500, seed=123, rationale=iter-19, CEILING-DOCUMENTATION confirmation probe (NOT a ceiling-raiser). SECOND-TO-LAST iter (iter-20 is the hard stop). Base = iter-18 (the val_n=24 basis point: SSIM 0.975450, PSNR 38.74 dB; proj_n_bf=1, proj_sr=0.0005, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5, n_iter=300, val_n=24, seed=42), which is the iter-12 CHAMPION recipe (val_n=16 SSIM 0.974822) re-scored on the larger 24-scene basis. ONE KNOB CHANGED: seed 42 -> 123 at the val_n=24 basis (isolated). EVERYTHING else identical to iter-18 (warm_start=True, pretrain_epochs=3, train_n=200, n_iter=300, val_n=24, batch_size=1, grad_clip=1.0, lr=5e-3, proj_n_bf=1, img_n_bf=3, img_sr=0.0005, proj_sr=0.0005, img_sx=img_sy=2.5; proj_sx/proj_sy/img_kernel/proj_kernel at Wagner-abdomen defaults). WHY A FRESH SEED AT THE VAL_N=24 BASIS IS THE HONEST PROBE NOW: ALL knob families are exhausted and characterized -- IMAGE-domain (range img_sr tight peak, depth img_n_bf=3 peak, kernel img_kernel 7->9 flat @iter-6, spatial img_sx/img_sy full 0.5/1.5/2.5/3.5 sweep flat) and PROJECTION-domain (range proj_sr=0.0005 peak / 0.0001 flat, depth proj_n_bf=2 flat, spatial proj_sx 1.0->0.5 DOWN @iter-14, proj_sy 2.0->0.5 flat @iter-15), plus n_iter (300->600 flat @iter-7) and pretrain_epochs. NO ceiling-raiser remains -- this is pure ceiling-documentation. The val_n=16 basis is already documented as seed-robust across THREE inits (iter-12 seed42 0.974822, iter-16 seed123 0.974834, iter-17 seed7 0.974843 -- tight 3-seed cluster, range 2.1e-5). The val_n=24 basis, by contrast, has only ONE data point (iter-18 seed42 0.975450). The complementary honest confirmation is a SECOND seed at that LARGER basis: it turns the single iter-18 val_n=24 read into a 2-seed reproducibility set, confirming the larger-basis ceiling (~0.9755) is seed-robust and not a single-seed lottery. HYPOTHESIS: seed 42->123 at val_n=24 lands SSIM at ~0.9755 (within +-0.0005 of iter-18's 0.975450). The 12-param bilateral has too few DOF to be seed-sensitive (only 12 sigma scalars warm-started from an amortized N2I init, then per-scan-fit on each image's OWN measurements -- no pixel-wise memory, no large param space for the seed to swing), and it is per-image self-supervised (each of the 24 val scenes fit on its OWN measurements, no shared model state across the seed flip), so the seed should reproduce the larger-basis ceiling, SEALING ~0.9755 (val_n=24) / 0.9748 (val_n=16) as the breast 128-view FBP-bounded representational ceiling: hr=0, PSNR ~38.7 ~1 dB under the 39.68 dB LD-FBP baseline -- the BF inductive bias approaches but cannot beat a clean 128-view breast FBP (mirroring dd-bf-supervised 0.9502 on Mayo). If instead SSIM swings by >0.0005, the per-scan fit has a seed-dependent noise floor (as demo-n2i's U-Net does) -- but the 12-param bilateral physically cannot overfit one scan, so a tight reproduction is expected. WALL: step budget IDENTICAL to iter-18 (n_iter=300, val_n=24; warm <=3x200=600 + per-image 24x300=7200); iter-18 ran 692 s, far under the 1800 s sbatch wall; outer_wall_s=1500 internal guard unchanged. ONE knob changed: seed 42->123 (isolated).
